meta.title: Configure options for Single Select and Radio

plan.title: Configure Single Select and Radio Options

steps.note: Open an eRFX create flow that supports a Technical Stage questionnaire.
Provide the required event title before configuring the technical stage.
Create a technical-only event so the question builder is available.
Work on the Technical Stage where questionnaire questions are configured.
Apply the technical-stage template so questionnaire configuration is enabled.

args.goal: In the Technical Stage questionnaire builder, open Add New Question, select Field Type Single Select, click Add Option and type an option, press Enter to add additional options, use Delete on one option, use Delete All to clear every option, re-add the intended remaining options, and click Add to save the question; verify the saved Single Select question lists exactly the options remaining after the edits. Repeat the same complete flow for Field Type Radio and verify its saved question lists exactly the options remaining after the edits.

steps.note: Perform and verify the option editing behavior for both field types, including the final saved option lists.
Confirm the questionnaire screen remains free of errors or broken UI after saving both questions.
